rationale: Liturgical-affirmation pair drawn from Pauline 2 Cor 1:20 (ναί καὶ ἀμήν). ⲥⲉ = Coptic affirmative 'yes' substantivized with article. The kephalaion exegetes this pair by identifying it with the cosmic Calling (ⲡⲧⲱⲍⲙⲉ) and Answer (ⲡⲟⲩⲱϣⲃⲉ/ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ). Documents a Manichaean liturgical-cosmological technical pair.

Hapax in this corpus. Identified in the text with the First Man (ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛⲣⲱⲙⲉ). Possibly a Greek-derived title (παράμονος 'abiding,' or related to Hermes/Aroman). May connect with earlier accumulated ⲡⲁⲣⲟⲙⲟⲥ 'Aromos.' Retained as transliterated proper name pending parallels.

Likely a nomen sacrum abbreviation for ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ 'Spirit.' Alternatives include ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ 'Mind' (Lyc vowel-shift) or ⲡⲛⲁⲟ 'Great One.' In context of Calling/Hearing 'opening their mouths to' a divine recipient, the cosmic Living Spirit fits best.

Unattested compound; possibly Lyc verbal-noun on ⲥⲱⲡⲥⲡ̄ 'beseech, supplicate' with directional ⲁⲃⲁⲗ. Pairs with 'the Spirit' as a recipient/object the Calling and Hearing 'opened their mouths to.' Confidence low.

Compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who') + ⲥⲱⲧϥ̄ ('draw, refine'). Distinguished from ⲣⲉϩⲥⲱⲧⲉ 'redeemer' (in glossary). The verb ⲥⲱⲧϥ̄ in Manichaean cosmology denotes the refining of captive light-substance from matter. Applied here to those who refine the Living Soul.
Compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who') + ϯ- ('give') + ⲃⲁⲙ ('power, strength'). Standard Coptic agentive formation paralleling ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher' and ⲣⲉϩ†ⲛⲁϣⲧⲉ 'strengthener' (in glossary).

Already in accumulated vocabulary as ⲡⲣⲉϩⲥⲱⲩⲥ ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ; the Lyc variant with ⲩⲍ for ⲩⲥ (regular ⲍ for ϩ assimilation in the gathering-stem ⲥⲱⲟⲩϩ) is documented here. Same Manichaean technical sense: the cosmic Gatherer-Inward, role of the Mind of Light/Calling-Hearing pair.
